purpose: 实例分割训练拟合问题的有限诊断，不是正式方法比较或论文结果

arms.name: original
arms.loss: unchanged BCE + Dice + original Gaussian focal center + 5*masked SmoothL1 offsets

arms.name: center_mse
arms.loss: same foreground and offsets; replace center term with 200*mean((sigmoid(center_logits)-Gaussian_target)^2)

interpretation: Original arm separates optimization-budget and augmentation effects from a center-loss change; it does not isolate those two schedule changes individually
The two new arms share data, initialization seed, architecture, optimizer and step budget; only center loss differs
Train fitting is a debugging criterion, not generalization, novelty or benchmark performance
No validation or test set score is used to tune decoder thresholds or select the new loss
Both arms stop at the declared budget even if the fitting gate fails
Any later architecture change requires another explicit version and preserves both results

reference.role: Gaussian center regression and loss scaling as design motivation only
reference.difference: The present diagnostic retains sigmoid center outputs, normalized SmoothL1 offsets, original pilot architecture and fixed decoder; it is not a reproduction of Panoptic-DeepLab
